create_tracking_module: create a TrackingModule instance with a Motion object and head, left wrist, and right wrist bone names
compute_tracking_series: compute a tracking series with transforms and velocities for head and wrist bones at a given timestamp
get_bone_transforms: get bone transformation matrices for tracked bones with optional Gaussian smoothing over a time window
get_bone_velocities: get bone velocities for tracked bones with optional Gaussian smoothing over a time window
draw_tracking_series: draw tracking series positions, velocities, and connections for head and wrist bones in the editor
